1-expert: Meet Maria: twenty-four years in accounts payable, half paper, half screen. The why behind her calls lives only in her head. She retires in three months.
2-screen: Maria shares her screen and just works. GroundZero stays quiet until the screen is still and her voice stops. Then it asks why, and keeps her exact words.
3-paper: Paper leaves no trace on screen, so the apprentice listens. What she says at the scanner becomes a physical step, and a QR code ties it to the invoice.
4-map: Then a debrief, and a teach-back she confirms. Out comes a Work Map: every step, physical or digital, with her decision, her words, and the guardrails.
5-teach: The new hire gets a coach for both halves: A R on the phone for the paper step, a voice tutor on the screen. It stops a wrong save before it happens, quoting Maria.
6-agent: And the next colleague can be an agent. The same Work Map exports guardrails, so on a case it has never seen, it stops where Maria would stop. GroundZero: capture, map, teach.
